CREATE TABLE world_image_provider_credentials (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	encrypted_secret TEXT, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(32), 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	tombstone BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	aad_character_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	aad_purpose VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(world_character_id, world_id) REFERENCES world_characters (id, world_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_world_image_provider_scope UNIQUE (owner_id, world_id, world_character_id, provider, purpose), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_world_image_provider_revision CHECK (revision >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_world_image_provider_purpose CHECK ((purpose='user_image' AND provider IN ('novelai','nanogpt','openrouter')) OR (purpose='comfy_partner_image' AND provider='comfyui')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(world_id) REFERENCES worlds (id)
)
